id, run_id, attempt_no, status, provider_type, model, voice, speed, pitch, style, output_format, text_snapshot, storage_key, audio_url, raw_response_snapshot, error_message, duration_ms, created_at, started_at, finished_at
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO share_summary_audio_config ( id, enabled, auto_generate, provider_type, base_url, endpoint_path, api_key, model, voice, speed, pitch, style, output_format, request_timeout_seconds, updated_at ) VALUES ( 1, #{enabled}, #{autoGenerate}, #{providerType}, #{baseUrl}, #{endpointPath}, #{apiKey}, #{model}, #{voice}, #{speed}, #{pitch}, #{style}, #{outputFormat}, #{requestTimeoutSeconds}, #{updatedAt} ) ON CONFLICT(id) DO UPDATE SET enabled = excluded.enabled, auto_generate = excluded.auto_generate, provider_type = excluded.provider_type, base_url = excluded.base_url, endpoint_path = excluded.endpoint_path, api_key = excluded.api_key, model = excluded.model, voice = excluded.voice, speed = excluded.speed, pitch = excluded.pitch, style = excluded.style, output_format = excluded.output_format, request_timeout_seconds = excluded.request_timeout_seconds, updated_at = excluded.updated_at

INSERT INTO share_summary_audio ( run_id, attempt_no, status, provider_type, model, voice, speed, pitch, style, output_format, text_snapshot, storage_key, audio_url, raw_response_snapshot, error_message, duration_ms, created_at, started_at, finished_at ) VALUES ( #{runId}, #{attemptNo}, #{status}, #{providerType}, #{model}, #{voice}, #{speed}, #{pitch}, #{style}, #{outputFormat}, #{textSnapshot}, #{storageKey}, #{audioUrl}, #{rawResponseSnapshot}, #{errorMessage}, #{durationMs}, #{createdAt}, #{startedAt}, #{finishedAt} )
mapper.update: UPDATE share_summary_audio SET status = #{status}, storage_key = #{storageKey}, audio_url = #{audioUrl}, raw_response_snapshot = #{rawResponseSnapshot}, error_message = #{errorMessage}, duration_ms = #{durationMs}, started_at = #{startedAt}, finished_at = #{finishedAt} WHERE id = #{id}

UPDATE share_summary_audio SET status = 'FAILED', error_message = #{errorMessage}, finished_at = #{finishedAt} WHERE status IN ('PENDING', 'GENERATING') AND COALESCE(started_at, created_at) < #{threshold}
mapper.select: SELECT FROM share_summary_audio WHERE run_id = #{runId} ORDER BY attempt_no DESC, id DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT FROM share_summary_audio WHERE run_id = #{runId} AND status = 'SUCCESS' ORDER BY attempt_no DESC, id DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT FROM share_summary_audio WHERE run_id = #{runId} AND status IN ('PENDING', 'GENERATING') ORDER BY attempt_no DESC, id DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT FROM share_summary_audio WHERE run_id = #{runId} ORDER BY attempt_no DESC, id DESC
